label: Bible Study
prompt: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I _____ him out of the water.
verse: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
note: Pharaoh's daughter names the baby from the basket — Moses, because she drew him out of the water.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will _____ with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
verse: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
note: God moves in with His people — Revelation's grand finale is a homecoming.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Came behind him, and touched the _____ of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verse: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
note: She only touched the border of his garment in a crowd — and Jesus still stopped to ask who touched him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be _____ of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verse: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
note: One of Scripture's boldest lines: through God's promises, believers come to share the divine nature itself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: So we fasted and _____ our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
verse: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
note: Ezra was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers (8:22), so the people fasted and 'besought' God instead — and he listened.
